question: Utkala Dibasa, is celebrated on 1 April in the Indian State of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The state of **Odisha** was formed on **1 April 1936**. This day is celebrated as **Utkala Dibasa** in **Odisha**.
 
• On this day, people pray for the** good health** of the state and its people.
 
• The struggle for** independence** for the** Odias** intensified with the formation of the **Utkal Sammilani**, a **cultural **and **social organization**. This organization was formed to fight for the formation of **Odisha** as an independent state.
 
• Earlier, **Odisha **was a part of the **Bihar** and **Orissa province**, and after significant **revolutionary efforts**, which lasted three decades, it was announced as an **independent state.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Madhusudan Das** -

 
 
• He became the first Odia to complete a BA, an MA, and then a BL degree.
 
• In 1881, he started his law practice in his home state.
 
• Not only was he a lawyer, but Madhu Babu (as he was called by the people) was also a prolific journalist, social worker, and legislator.
 
• He became the first person of Odia descent to enter the Bengal provincial legislative council and also the Central Legislative Assembly.
 
• He strove for the unification of all Odia-speaking regions and through his efforts, the state of Odisha was formed on 1 April 1936. This day is celebrated as Utkala Dibasa in Odisha. Thus he is called the maker of modern Odisha.
 
• He was the Vice President of the Utkal Sabha in 1889.
 
• He also protested against the unjust salt tax laws of the British government in 1888 long before Mahatma Gandhi took up the Dandi March.
 
• His birth anniversary is marked as ‘Lawyers’ Day’ in Odisha. i.e., 28 April.
